description: Indian Supreme Court judgments from the AWS Open Data dataset (CC-BY-4.0): for a judgment year, returns judgment IDs, neutral citation and the scrape date of up to 3 metadata records. Metadata only; full judgment text is not included and case titles are not in the metadata fields used. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_court_records_ecourt_india when you need Indian High Court judgments and final orders; gov_global_court_records_aggregator when you need Court records from two official open sources in one answer. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: gov_india_supreme_court
title: Indian Supreme Court judgments from the AWS Open Data
